limitations: Test-only run for the pure helpers; no library, package or export artifacts are delivered.

Before implementation the same helper tests failed as intended (12 of 15 text tests on NotImplemented, then the 3 transform tests and the 20000-double decoding test); those red runs are described in the pull request, not retained as logs.

The broad engine regression run was not repeated; it is known to fail with the held-layer-page SIGSEGV against the shared linux-arm64 PDFium build tracked in https://github.com/roanutil/embed-pdf-viewer/issues/16. The helpers do not call PDFium.
Only Linux arm64 native container execution is validated here. Linux x64, macOS arm64/x64 and Windows x64 have no native helper validation record in this slice.
